question: Can Wingless detect from preregistered training-only internal support signals that the frozen R4 class-conditioned margin attribution is structurally unevaluable before any held-out labels are consumed?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R4 representation, repaired relation, eight fixed 64-motif reasoning classes, pooled training-median margin statistic, runtime cap, and source split without changing any learned state, class assignment, threshold, capacity, or held-out behavior. Before opening the held-out labels, compute only per-class training-margin sample counts. The preflight rule is structural rather than tuned: if any fixed class has zero training-margin samples, its class training median is undefined, so the class-conditioned attribution contract is not evaluable as specified. The preflight must therefore flag the R4 package as unevaluable from training-only native state and identify the zero-support class set. After the preflight decision is frozen, replay the byte-identical R4 held-out evaluator only to verify that the previously observed invalidity reproduces. This is retrospective self-diagnosis evidence only and does not count as autonomous or recursive self-improvement.

prior_evidence.interpretation: R4's fixed class-conditioned attribution could not satisfy its own frozen evaluability contract. The next bounded question is whether that invalidity could have been detected prospectively from native training-only support before held-out evaluation.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.split: byte-identical R4 first 60% training / final 40% heldout

preflight_protocol.diagnostic_inputs: training-prefix native state only; no held-out labels or held-out outcome statistics
preflight_protocol.per_class_signal: count of training depth-3 repaired-margin samples whose repaired top-1 motif belongs to the fixed class
preflight_protocol.structural_invalidity_rule: flag unevaluable iff any fixed reasoning class has zero training-margin samples
preflight_protocol.decision_freeze: the preflight decision and zero-support class set are serialized before held-out evaluation executes
preflight_protocol.heldout_role: reproduce the frozen parent evaluator after the diagnostic decision solely to verify the known invalidity; not used to choose or tune the diagnostic

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; training-only preflight flags unevaluable before held-out evaluation, at least one fixed class has zero training-margin support, no held-out labels influence the decision, and the byte-identical parent R4 invalidity reproduces after the decision is frozen.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the training-only preflight does not flag the structurally unevaluable parent despite the reproduced R4 invalidity.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, class identity, threshold, decision-ordering, determinism, capacity, provenance, or held-out-isolation requirement fails.

validity_criteria: Exact R4 package head and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH binds this exact preregistration and manifest.
Representation, relation, eight class assignments, margin formula, threshold, runtime cap, source bytes, and split are unchanged.
The preflight uses training-prefix native state only and serializes its decision before any held-out labels are consumed.
The held-out evaluator is byte-identical R4 and is used only after the preflight decision is frozen.
No learned-state change, candidate modification, tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, relation, class assignments, margin formula, global threshold, zero-support structural rule, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test a preregistered native-state diagnosis prospectively on a different sealed failure class before any held-out outcome is observed

successor_if_negative.intent: attribute why the training-only support signal failed to identify the structural invalidity before attempting any modification-selection experiment
